🗳️ Today is Local Government Elections day, and a public holiday.

Your municipality controls a big part of your monthly budget: property rates, water and refuse charges, electricity tariffs if it supplies your power, and how fast potholes and streetlights get fixed. Your vote today chooses who sets those bills for the next five years.

Got your ID? Know your voting station? Make it count. 👇

#MzansiMoneyMatters #LGE2026 #Vote
